lines.en: label sportswars6:
scene obstacles1
: Hello and welcome to everyone who’s decided to tune in for this year’s broadcast of the-
lines.zh: : 各位观众大家好，欢迎收看今年的转播——

lines.en: : Super Mega Ultimate Sports-Day Dorm Wars: No Boys Allowed! The Extremely Awesome and Only Kind of Sad Special Event for Bonding and Battling!
lines.zh: : 超级无敌究极运动会·宿舍大战：男生禁止入内！超厉害、也有那么点可悲的「增进感情与互相厮杀」特别活动！

lines.en: : And apologies for the title being so long that it required its own text box! I’m your host and sole teacher of Class A, Imani Imai! And joining me today are Miku Maruyama and Touka Tsukioka.
lines.zh: : 顺便为这个长到需要单独占一个文本框的标题致歉！我是主持人，也是 A 班唯一的老师，Imani Imai！今天和我一同主持的是 Miku Maruyama 和 Touka Tsukioka。

lines.en: scene obstacles2
: Wakana and Good Kid are here as well. Say hi, Wakana.
lines.zh: : Wakana 和 Good Kid 也在。打个招呼吧，Wakana。

lines.en: : I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我想死。

lines.en: scene obstacles3
: Well said, Wakana. I’m sure that the viewers at home are happy to hear that, despite the many changes we’ve been faced with concerning this year’s contest, some things never change.
lines.zh: : 说得好，Wakana。我相信家里的观众听到这句话会很欣慰——尽管今年的比赛经历了诸多变动，有些东西却从未改变。

lines.en: : What’s another example of something that never changes, Miku?
lines.zh: : 还有一个「从未改变」的例子是什么，Miku？

lines.en: : Call of Duty!
lines.zh: : 《使命召唤》！

lines.en: : Wrong answer. Touka?
lines.zh: : 答错了。Touka？

lines.en: : Um...US Treasury bond yields?
lines.zh: : 呃……美国国债收益率？

lines.en: : What you guys were supposed to say is the rivalry between the first and second floors of the dorm!
lines.zh: : 你们该说的，是宿舍一楼和二楼之间的宿怨才对！

lines.en: scene obstacles4
: Just like Wakana’s outlook on life, the infinite civil war raging between both halves of Class A never changes!
lines.zh: : 就像 Wakana 的人生观一样，A 班两派之间无休无止的内战也从未改变！

lines.en: : And while I’m sure this battle won’t put an end to that, it will give both sides one more opportunity to show the other who’s the best!
lines.zh: : 虽然我敢肯定这场较量不会终结它，但它会给双方再一次机会，向对方证明谁才是最强的！

lines.en: scene obstacles5
: But, more importantly than that, it will finally give Touka the opportunity to show us that physical prowess she’s been talking up for a total of four wars now! Anything you’d like to add, Touka?
lines.zh: : 但更重要的是，它终于给了 Touka 一个机会，向我们展示她已经吹了整整四届大赛的体能！Touka，有什么要补充的吗？

lines.en: : Yes! I’m very excited to finally compete in something that will show the viewers at home I can be much more than a sheltered and extremely wealthy young woman.
lines.zh: : 有！我非常兴奋，终于能参加一个项目，向家里的观众证明，我可以不只是个被娇生惯养、又极其有钱的年轻女人。

lines.en: : And I can think of no better opponent for such a contest than Miku Maruyama herself.
lines.zh: : 而对这样的比赛，我想不出比 Miku Maruyama 本人更合适的对手了。

lines.en: scene obstacles6
: And Miku! What would you like to say in response to Touka’s opening statement?
lines.zh: : 那 Miku 呢！对于 Touka 的开场宣言，你有什么想回应的？

lines.en: : Makoto said she’ll get mad at me if I say anything good about any of our opponents throughout the whole war thing, so I’m gonna go with “no comment!”
lines.zh: : Makoto 说了，要是我在整场大战里说对手半句好话，她就会生气，所以我的回答是——「无可奉告！」

lines.en: scene obstacles7
: You heard it here first, folks! And, if you haven’t already guessed by the crazy amount of weird set pieces behind me, round three of this year’s Dorm Wars will be the obstacle course!
lines.zh: : 各位，这可是独家首播！而且，要是你们还没从我身后那一大堆稀奇古怪的布景猜出来——今年宿舍大战的第三轮就是障碍赛！

lines.en: : But it’s not just any obstacle course. It’s Imani Imai’s super spectacular obstacle course that will put not just these girls’ bodies to the test, but their mental fortitude and creativity as well!
lines.zh: : 但这可不是一般的障碍赛。这是 Imani Imai 的超华丽障碍赛，考验的不仅是这些姑娘的身体，还有她们的心理韧性与创造力！

lines.en: : Before we begin, though, please be advised that we’ve had to remove the “battle to the death” portion of the obstacle course as weapons are not allowed in school.
lines.zh: : 不过在开始之前，请注意：由于校内禁止携带武器，我们不得不取消了障碍赛中的「死斗」环节。

lines.en: : If only we were competing in the States.
lines.zh: : 要是在美国比赛就好了。

lines.en: scene obstacles8
: This course is divided into six sections and will not be ruled “complete” until one of you escapes the ring and lights the brazier at the finish line.
lines.zh: : 这条赛道分为六个区段，只有当你们其中一人逃出擂台、点燃终点的火盆时，才算「完成」。

lines.en: : Obstacle one is the Sea of Balls’ reclamation of scales!
lines.zh: : 第一个障碍是「球之海·鳞片的归还」！

lines.en: : Got it!
lines.zh: : 明白！

lines.en: : The...the what?
lines.zh: : 什么……什么来着？

lines.en: : The Sea of Balls’ reclamation of scales! Pay attention! You’ve got enough of a handicap as-is with those water balloons strapped to your chest.
lines.zh: : 「球之海·鳞片的归还」！集中注意力！你们胸口还绑着那些水气球，本来就已经够吃亏了。

lines.en: : Can I...ask for clarity as to what exactly that obstacle entails?
lines.zh: : 我能不能……请教一下这个障碍具体要做什么？

lines.en: : Jump into the ball pit and find a fish!
lines.zh: : 跳进球池里，找一条鱼！

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene obstacles9
: Then bring it over to the Wise Turtle and offer it up in exchange for your vows.
lines.zh: : 然后把它带到智慧龟面前献上，换取你们的誓言。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene obstacles10
: After you’ve done that, you’ll move over to obstacle three and get married! But don’t take too long, since it will be time for your vitamins right after that!
lines.zh: : 完成之后，你们就前往第三个障碍——结婚！不过别拖太久，因为紧接着就是你们的维他命时间！

lines.en: : Understood!
lines.zh: : 了解！

lines.en: : Am I being deceived again? Because this sounds a lot like something Sensei would orchestrate to take advantage of my naiveté and kind heart.
lines.zh: : 我又被骗了吗？因为听起来很像 Sensei 会为了利用我的天真和善良而安排的东西。

lines.en: : Just sounds like a normal obstacle course to me. I’m guessin’ we steal the pirate’s treasure after that?
lines.zh: : 我听着就是个普通的障碍赛嘛。我猜接下来是不是要偷海盗的宝藏？

lines.en: scene obstacles11
: Exactly! And you’ll then use that treasure to light the brazier after escaping the ring! Any questions?
lines.zh: : 正是！然后用那批宝藏在逃出擂台之后点燃火盆！还有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Is it too late to ask for another competition? Because I’m beginning to think that, once again, this competition will not allow me to adequately express my strengths.
lines.zh: : 有。现在换成别的项目还来不来得及？因为我开始觉得，这个项目又一次无法让我充分展现自己的长处。

lines.en: scene black
: It is too late! But don’t worry! You both have three minutes to formulate your game plans before the obstacle course begins! Just don’t plan out loud or it will make the Wise Turtle mad!
lines.zh: : 来不及了！不过别担心！障碍赛开始前，你们各有三分钟来制定战术！只是别把计划说出来，否则智慧龟会生气的！

lines.en: : This joke is carrying on for far too long, Miss Imai!
lines.zh: : 这个玩笑拖得太久了，Imai 老师！

lines.en: scene obstacles12
: I’m glad to see you’re okay now, Sana. You really had us worried when you took that egg to the face.
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到你没事了，Sana。你被那颗蛋砸中脸的时候，我们真的很担心。

lines.en: : It’s fine...I’m just glad Ayane wasn’t using her full power or...I probably would have actually died...
lines.zh: : 没事……我只是庆幸 Ayane 没使出全力，不然……我可能真的会死……

lines.en: : It’s...unfortunate that we lost, though...I know everyone was counting on us and...and stuff...
lines.zh: : 不过……输了还是挺遗憾的……我知道大家都很指望我们，还有……之类的……

lines.en: : One loss doesn’t mean much. Besides, this is a pretty low-stakes competition. And I’m almost positive the entire purpose behind it is to sort of...cheer everybody up.
lines.zh: : 输一场说明不了什么。再说了，这比赛的风险本来就很低。而且我几乎可以肯定，它的全部目的大概就是……让大家开心起来。

lines.en: : But you’ve actually seemed kind of...content lately. You’re more...cheerful than normal.
lines.zh: : 不过你最近看起来倒是……挺满足的。你比平时……更开朗了。

lines.en: scene obstacles13
: Is...that so?...
lines.zh: : 是……这样吗？……

lines.en: : Mhm. And I’m not the only one who seems to think that as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯。而且这么觉得的人不止我一个。

lines.en: : Did something happen?
lines.zh: : 发生了什么事吗？

lines.en: : Nothing...in particular...
lines.zh: : 没什么……特别的……

lines.en: : But I guess...you could say I’m...learning more about...who I really am...or...something like that...
lines.zh: : 不过我想……可以说我……正在更多地了解……真正的自己……或者……诸如此类的吧……

lines.en: : Well, whatever it is, I’m happy for you. I can tell you’ve worked really hard to get to where you are today.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管是什么，我都为你高兴。看得出来你很努力才走到今天。

lines.en: scene obstacles14
: You...seem a little different from how you used to be as well...
lines.zh: : 你……看起来也和以前不太一样了……

lines.en: : Do I?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...maybe...you’re feeling a little more confident too now?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许……你现在也更有自信了一点？……

lines.en: : Futaba?
lines.zh: : Futaba？

lines.en: scene obstacles15
: AND THEY’RE OFF!!!
lines.zh: : 比赛开始！！！

lines.en: : Both contestants dive into the ball pit and are likely fighting off alligators as we speak! But don’t worry! They’re only babies and will likely only do minimal damage to them!
lines.zh: : 两位选手都扎进了球池，这会儿大概正在和短吻鳄搏斗！不过别担心！它们还只是幼崽，大概只会造成最小程度的伤害！

lines.en: : Imani, please tell me you did not put actual alligators in the-
lines.zh: : Imani，请告诉我你没有真的把鳄鱼放进——

lines.en: : Shhhh, it’ll be fine! There are plenty of weapons down there for the girls to protect themselves with! And I’m sure we’ll see one whenever they have to come up for air!
lines.zh: : 嘘，没问题的！下面有的是武器供姑娘们自卫！而且我相信她们浮上来换气的时候，我们总该看见了！

lines.en: scene obstacles16
: Why are there so many bananas in this pool of plastic balls?!
lines.zh: : 这个塑料球池里为什么有这么多香蕉？！

lines.en: : Because I couldn’t throw a bunch of baby alligators in there without giving them something to eat. Come on, Touka. Have some common sense.
lines.zh: : 因为我总不能把一群小鳄鱼扔进去却不给它们吃的吧。拜托，Touka。有点常识好吗。

lines.en: scene obstacles17
: Is that what keeps touching my leg?! An alligator?!
lines.zh: : 一直碰我腿的就是那个东西？！鳄鱼？！

lines.en: scene obstacles18
: Finally! It was well-hidden, but-
lines.zh: : 终于！它藏得可真够深的，不过——

lines.en: scene obstacles19
: What a curious sculpture. And surprisingly accurate as well. I admire the artistry, but I don’t believe that counts as a fish.
lines.zh: : 好奇怪的雕塑。而且意外地逼真。我很欣赏这工艺，但我不认为这能算是一条鱼。

lines.en: : Imani. Why? Why is this an item you possess?
lines.zh: : Imani。为什么？你为什么会拥有这种东西？

lines.en: : Yo, porn shop lady can talk me into buying literally anything and there ain’t no way I’m actually gonna use that thing. So hey. Obstacle course.
lines.zh: : 喂，成人用品店的老板娘什么都能忽悠我买，而且这玩意儿我是绝对不可能真的用上的。所以嘛，拿来当障碍赛道具咯。

lines.en: scene obstacles17
: STOP PUTTING WEIRD STUFF IN THE BALL PIT! AIN’T YOU EVER GONE TO A PLAY CENTER BEFORE?! THAT’S RULE NUMBER ONE!
lines.zh: : 别再往球池里塞奇怪的东西了！你难道没去过儿童游乐场吗？！这是第一条规矩！

lines.en: : What would you possibly use that for? It’s art, is it not?
lines.zh: : 那东西能拿来干什么？它不是艺术品吗？

lines.en: : It is an art, sure. Just ask Wakana. She has a demon one. And they must be used carefully or-
lines.zh: : 它确实是一门艺术。不信你去问 Wakana。她有一个恶魔款的。而且使用时必须小心，不然——

lines.en: scene obstacles15
: I DON’T WANT TO HEAR IT!
lines.zh: : 我不想听！

lines.en: : And they’re back down!
lines.zh: : 她们又潜下去了！

lines.en: : Can you please refrain from saying such damning things on national television?
lines.zh: : 能不能请你别在全国转播里说这种要命的话？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t worry. The longer this drags on, the more viewers we’ll inevitably lose.
lines.zh: : 我倒不担心。拖得越久，观众流失得就越多。

lines.en: scene obstacles20
: How the heck do I get this thing off of me?!
lines.zh: : 我到底要怎么把这玩意儿弄下来？！

lines.en: : Hey! Miku found the blobfish! Which means that any second now, Touka will probably-
lines.zh: : 嘿！Miku 找到了水滴鱼！这意味着随时可能发生的是，Touka 大概会——

lines.en: scene obstacles21
: WHY ARE THERE SO MANY BANANAS?! IT’S ALL BANANAS! THERE IS NO WAY THESE BELONG IN HERE!
lines.zh: : 为什么有这么多香蕉？！全都是香蕉！这些东西绝对不该出现在这里！

lines.en: : It ain’t all bananas! I got a frickin’ blob thing latchin’ on to my finger!
lines.zh: : 才不全都是香蕉！我这手指头上还黏着个该死的软趴趴的东西呢！

lines.en: scene obstacles20
: And I have an alligator getting way too comfortable with my leg! Your problems mean nothing to me!
lines.zh: : 我这儿还有只鳄鱼正和我大腿亲热得很呢！你的问题对我来说不值一提！

lines.en: : This thing is...really frickin’ on there! Medic! Medic!
lines.zh: : 这玩意儿……粘得真他妈紧！卫生员！卫生员！

lines.en: scene obstacles22
: I have returned! And without a fruit this time!
lines.zh: : 我回来了！而且这次没带水果！

lines.en: : Gah! Hope the Wise Turtle won’t mind gettin’ some fingers as a sacrifice too cause I ain’t stickin’ around to watch banana girl take a lead!
lines.zh: : 啊！希望智慧龟不介意连几根手指一起当祭品吧，因为我可不想留在这儿看香蕉女领先！

lines.en: scene obstacles23
: You touched a horse penis!
lines.zh: : 你摸了马的阴茎！

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’ve probably touched a real one!
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过你大概摸过真的！

lines.en: scene obstacles15
: Not intentionally!
lines.zh: : 我又不是故意的！

lines.en: : Imani, what is this nonsense?
lines.zh: : Imani，这都是什么鬼东西？

lines.en: scene obstacles24
: Awesome, that’s what!
lines.zh: : 是「超赞」，就是这么回事！

lines.en: : Fresh out of the ball pit, both contests appear before the Wise Turtle with their gifts! But, in true Japanese fashion, Touka must wait in line as Miku was the first to arrive!
lines.zh: : 刚从球池里爬出来，两位选手就带着各自的贡品出现在智慧龟面前！不过，按照日本人的规矩，Touka 得排队等着，因为是 Miku 先到的！

lines.en: : What do I do now?!
lines.zh: : 现在该做什么？！

lines.en: : Convince the Wise Turtle to accept your sacrifice!
lines.zh: : 说服智慧龟接受你的祭品！

lines.en: : Accept my sacrifice, Wise Turtle!
lines.zh: : 请接受我的祭品，智慧龟！

lines.en: : The Wise Turtle appears to be just another statue, Miku. It can not possibly accept your-
lines.zh: : 智慧龟看起来不过是另一座雕像而已，Miku。它不可能接受你的——

lines.en: : Your sacrifice has been accepted, Miku Maruyama. Feel the vows deep within your heart.
lines.zh: : 你的祭品已被接受，Miku Maruyama。去感受你内心深处的誓言吧。

lines.en: scene obstacles25
: It talks?!?!?!
: Heck yeah it does! Thanks, Wise Turtle! I know now what I must do!
lines.zh: : 当然会啦！谢了，智慧龟！我现在知道该做什么了！

lines.en: scene black
: W...Wise Turtle! Please accept my sacrifice as well!
lines.zh: : 智……智慧龟！请也接受我的祭品！

lines.en: : Your sacrifice has been accepted, Touma Tsumioma. Feel the-
lines.zh: : 你的祭品已被接受，Touma Tsumioma。去感受——

lines.en: : AAAAAAHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: scene obstacles26
: Now what?! What do we do next?!
lines.zh: : 现在怎么办？！接下来要做什么？！

lines.en: : Now, our contestants must overcome the greatest obstacle of all! Holy matrimony! Complete with the filing of the required paperwork and the depressing knowledge that there is a 50%% chance of divorce!
lines.zh: : 现在，我们的选手必须跨越最伟大的障碍——神圣的婚姻！包括提交所需文件，以及「有 50% 概率离婚」这个令人沮丧的事实！

lines.en: : Disregarding the facts that same-sex couples cannot even get married in this country and that I am not an ordained minister, Maruyama — your vows, please.
lines.zh: : 先不提在这个国家同性伴侣根本无法结婚、以及我并不是受任牧师这两点——Maruyama，请说出你的誓言。

lines.en: scene obstacles27
: Touka, even though you’ve accidentally touched a horse wiener at least once, I’ve always loved you and am ready to spend the rest of my life with you.
lines.zh: : Touka，尽管你至少不小心摸过一次马的小鸡鸡，但我一直爱着你，也已经准备好和你共度余生。

lines.en: : I think you’re swell and that we’ll be good at being married and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你很棒，而且我们结婚之后肯定会过得很好之类的。

lines.en: : Is that really what the Wise Turtle wanted you to say?
lines.zh: : 智慧龟真的想让你说这个吗？

lines.en: scene obstacles28
: Yeah. Why? What does he want you to say?
lines.zh: : 是啊。怎么了？他想让你说什么？

lines.en: : Tsukioka — your vows. Out with them. This is cutting into my lunch break.
lines.zh: : Tsukioka——该你的誓言了。快说。这都占用我的午休时间了。

lines.en: : Touka, hurry the heck up! I ain’t allowed to take my vitamins until you say your vows! Which, if ya think about it, doesn’t make any sense for a friggin’ 1v1 obstacle course!
lines.zh: : Touka，搞快点！你不说完誓言我就不许吃维他命！话说回来，仔细想想，这对一个他妈的一对一障碍赛来说根本说不通啊！

lines.en: : Overcoming unfair rules and regulations is an obstacle too! I’ve done nothing wrong!
lines.zh: : 克服不合理的规则与规定本身也是一种障碍！我没有做错任何事！

lines.en: : Miku Maruyama-
lines.zh: : Miku Maruyama——

lines.en: : Munch on deez nuts. I will never marry you. The Wise Turtle has spoken.
lines.zh: : 去啃我这俩蛋吧。我永远都不会和你结婚。智慧龟已经降下神谕。

lines.en: scene obstacles29
: What the heck?! I loved you!
lines.zh: : 搞什么鬼？！我那么爱你！

lines.en: : The wedding is off. Both contestants may advance to vitamin time.
lines.zh: : 婚礼取消。两位选手可以进入维他命环节了。

lines.en: : My life used to be so easy. How did this happen?
lines.zh: : 我的人生以前多轻松啊。怎么会变成这样？

lines.en: scene black
: This is the price ya pay for joinin’ us commoners! Now get ready to take your damn vitamins!
lines.zh: : 这就是你加入我们平民要付的代价！现在准备好吃你那该死的维他命吧！

lines.en: scene obstacles30
: Okay, but...which ones?
lines.zh: : 好吧，可是……吃哪一种？

lines.en: : I’m glad you asked, Touka! Because this is actually the most important and unique obstacle of all!
lines.zh: : 很高兴你问这个，Touka！因为这其实是所有障碍里最重要、最独特的一个！

lines.en: : First, you have to-
lines.zh: : 首先，你们得——

lines.en: scene obstacles31
: Do you ever miss our other school? Because this place really sucks without Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你有没有想念我们以前那所学校？没有 Sensei，这地方真的很烂。

lines.en: : It sucks with him too. But I’m pretty sure that’s just part of what being a teenager is about. Nobody really likes high school from what I understand. At least not while they’re there.
lines.zh: : 有他在也一样烂。不过我敢说，这大概就是身为青少年的必经之路。据我所知，没人真的喜欢高中。至少在身在其中时不会。

lines.en: : Yeah but, teaching stuff aside, at least people kind of left me alone at our last school. The more time I spend in this one, the more people wind up getting on my nerves.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，不过抛开教学的事不谈，至少在以前那所学校，大家基本都不来烦我。在这儿待得越久，招我烦的人就越多。

lines.en: : I take it that means the trivia contest didn’t exactly go well?
lines.zh: : 听这意思，知识竞赛进行得不太顺利？

lines.en: : I lost. But it wasn’t, like...a decimation or anything. Some of those girls just piss me off. Like that blonde who isn’t a blonde anymore but still acts like a blonde.
lines.zh: : 我输了。不过也谈不上……被碾得体无完肤什么的。就是有些女生让我火大。比如那个已经不是金发了、却还一副金发做派的女生。

lines.en: scene obstacles32
: Chika’s not that bad. She actually seems like a really good person to have on your side. And I say that as someone who most definitely does not have her on my side after the whole Rin thing.
lines.zh: : Chika 没那么糟。她其实看起来是很值得站在你这边的那种人。而我这么说，是因为在 Rin 那件事之后，我显然已经不在她那边了。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot you had a lesbian phase. Ew.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我都忘了你还经历过一段同性恋期。恶。

lines.en: : Why Rin anyway? She’s loud and weird. You can do way better.
lines.zh: : 话说为什么是 Rin？她又吵又怪。你能找到好得多的。

lines.en: scene obstacles33
: Timing, maybe?
lines.zh: : 也许是时机吧？

lines.en: : She’s the first person I felt like giving a shot to. And she’s not bad either. Things just didn’t work out.
lines.zh: : 她是第一个让我想试一试的人。而且她也不差。只是事情没能成。

lines.en: : If anything, you and me are the assholes for not giving as much of a shit as everyone else. Like, what would anyone have to gain from talking to either one of us?
lines.zh: : 要说的话，反而是你和我才是混蛋，因为我们不像其他人那么在乎。话说回来，跟我们俩任何一个人说话，谁又能得到什么好处？

lines.en: scene obstacles34
: Chika fiercely defends everyone she loves. Rin’s great at coming up with plans and can get you discounts on coffee whenever you want.
lines.zh: : Chika 会拼命守护她爱的每一个人。Rin 很擅长出谋划策，还能随时帮你弄到咖啡折扣。

lines.en: : And, I’m assuming you don’t like Noriko either, but she’s probably the most selfless and generous person I’ve ever met.
lines.zh: : 还有，我猜你也不喜欢 Noriko，但她大概是我见过最无私、最慷慨的人。

lines.en: : You and me, though? What do we bring to the table? What right do we have to talk down on anyone when we’re just...projects, I guess.
lines.zh: : 可你和我呢？我们能拿出什么？我们自己都不过是……半成品吧，又有什么资格看不起别人。

lines.en: : Not saying you’re wrong about any of that, but...when the hell did you get so depressing?
lines.zh: : 我不是说你说得不对，不过……你到底什么时候变得这么丧了？

lines.en: scene obstacles35
: Probably when I came here, to be honest. So yeah, I do miss our old school.
lines.zh: : 说实话，大概就是我来到这儿之后吧。所以没错，我确实想念我们以前的学校。

lines.en: : I miss people liking me for no reason other than the fact that I was just cool or well-known around the campus.
lines.zh: : 我怀念那种毫无理由的喜欢——只因为我很酷，或者在校园里小有名气。

lines.en: : Starting from zero means you have to work for shit. And since neither one of us has actually done that yet, we’re just stuck in the mud now.
lines.zh: : 从零开始意味着什么都得自己挣。而我们俩都还没真正付出过努力，所以现在只能陷在泥里。

lines.en: : Is that really how we want to be forever? Like, anxiety aside, don’t you think it would be rad to kind of, like...enjoy people other than Uta some day?
lines.zh: : 我们真想永远这样吗？抛开焦虑不谈，你难道不觉得，要是有一天能……喜欢上 Uta 以外的人，会很棒吗？

lines.en: scene obstacles36
: I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : Miku’s not bad. Like, there are definitely parts about her that I don’t like. A lot of them. But we have more in common than I expected with our shitty brain stuff.
lines.zh: : Miku 不差。当然，她身上确实有我不喜欢的地方。而且还不少。但在「脑子有毛病」这件事上，我们的共同点比我想象的多。

lines.en: : Rin has shitty brain stuff too. She just always holes herself up in her room whenever it kicks in, so it’s harder to see out in the open than a full-blown panic attack would be.
lines.zh: : Rin 脑子也有毛病。只是一发作她就总是把自己关在房间里，所以不像彻底惊恐发作那样容易被人看见。

lines.en: : Yeah, but fucking everyone has depression nowadays. It’s nothing to write home about.
lines.zh: : 是吗，可现在他妈谁都有抑郁症啊。这有什么好大惊小怪的。

lines.en: : Have you seen what she does to her arms?
lines.zh: : 你见过她对自己手臂做的事吗？

lines.en: : Not...directly. But self mutilation is very common within our age group and isn’t something to write home about either.
lines.zh: : 没有……亲眼见过。不过自残在我们这个年龄段很常见，也没什么好大惊小怪的。

lines.en: : Io...can you look at me for a second?
lines.zh: : Io……你能看我一下吗？

lines.en: scene obstacles37
: Sure.
lines.zh: : 可以。

lines.en: : I get that traumatizing shit has happened to you at some point in your life, but you know better than to laugh at what other people have to deal with, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 我知道你人生中经历过一些创伤，但你总该明白，不该嘲笑别人所承受的东西吧？

lines.en: : Not really. I’ll laugh at whatever I want to laugh at. And the fact that some people act like their trauma is the end of the world when there are people way worse off than them is kind of hysterical.
lines.zh: : 并不。我想笑什么就笑什么。而且明明有人比他们惨得多，他们却表现得像是世界末日一样，这本身就挺滑稽的。

lines.en: : Did you expect me to say something else?
lines.zh: : 你以为我会说别的？

lines.en: : Yeah...that was a really disgusting thing to say. And I figured that if anyone would know not to do that, it would be the girl who has a handful of pills for breakfast every morning.
lines.zh: : 是啊……那话真够恶心的。我本来以为，要说有谁该懂这个道理，那就是每天早上把一把药片当早餐的女孩。

lines.en: : That’s why we’re just acquaintances and not friends. We don’t know each other well.
lines.zh: : 所以我们只是熟人，不是朋友。我们彼此并不了解。

lines.en: : Yeah. And that makes me kind of glad.
lines.zh: : 是啊。这反而让我有点庆幸。

lines.en: scene obstacles38
: Because if we were friends...and you laughed at Rin for her depression while I was dating her, I would have beaten the shit out of you.
lines.zh: : 因为如果我们是朋友……而你在我和 Rin 交往的时候嘲笑她的抑郁症，我会把你打得满地找牙。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, what’s stopping you from doing that now?
lines.zh: : 那现在又是什么拦着你不动手？

lines.en: scene black
: Probably pity.
lines.zh: : 大概是怜悯吧。

lines.en: scene obstacles39
: Wha- Imani, what the heck are these things?!
lines.zh: : 啥——Imani，这些东西到底是什么鬼？！

lines.en: : Oh! Ladies and gentlemen, it looks like Miku has made it to the top of the pirate ship! Which means she has encountered the secret stash of blow torches and is ready to escape the ring!
lines.zh: : 哦！女士们先生们，看来 Miku 已经爬到了海盗船的顶端！这意味着她发现了藏在那里的喷枪，准备好逃出擂台了！

lines.en: : How the heck am I gonna learn how to use a blow torch on such short notice?!
lines.zh: : 这么短的时间，我到底要怎么学会用喷枪啊？！

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll be fine, Miku. Such a task will be nothing compared to the utter hell that was the vitamin portion of the obstacle course.
lines.zh: : 你肯定没问题的，Miku。比起障碍赛里那个维他命环节的地狱，这点小事根本不算什么。

lines.en: scene obstacles40
: Yeah, I probably ain’t ever gonna look at VR technology the same after that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，在那之后我大概再也没法用同样的眼光看待 VR 技术了。

lines.en: : I thought that part was fine. It was the segment involving the people of Estonia that impacted me the most.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那部分还好。对我冲击最大的是涉及爱沙尼亚人民的那个环节。

lines.en: : Time is running out, you two! You better hurry or the pirate ship will explode!
lines.zh: : 时间不多了，你们两个！最好快点，不然海盗船就要爆炸了！

lines.en: scene obstacles41
: What?! Ya never said anythin’ about a friggin’ time limit!
lines.zh: : 什么？！你压根没提过还有什么他妈的时间限制！

lines.en: : The time limit is the hidden eighth obstacle you must overcome as well! Good luck, girls! Failure to complete the task on time will result in negative ten points!
lines.zh: : 时间限制就是你们必须克服的隐藏第八障碍！祝好运，姑娘们！未能按时完成任务将扣十分！

lines.en: scene black
: This is startin’ to get ridiculous, Imani!
lines.zh: : 这开始变得离谱了，Imani！

lines.en: : Starting to get ridiculous?...
lines.zh: : 「开始」变得离谱？……

lines.en: scene obstacles42
: I knew practicin’ my army crawl would come in handy sooner rather than later!
lines.zh: : 我就知道，练过低姿匍匐迟早会派上用场！

lines.en: : Speak for yourself! Squeezing under this...net with...breasts this size is proving to be rather difficult!
lines.zh: : 你倒是说得好听！带着……这么大的胸部从这张网底下挤过去，实在相当困难！

lines.en: scene obstacles43
: Then leave ‘em behind! Ain’t nobody ever gonna see all those redeemin’ qualities of yours with those things in the way!
lines.zh: : 那就把它们扔下呗！有那两坨挡着，谁也看不见你那堆「可取之处」！

lines.en: : You may not understand this due to the fact that you have not started growing yet, but they do not detach! I can not simply “leave them behind!”
lines.zh: : 你可能不明白，因为你还没开始发育，但它们是不可拆卸的！我没办法就这么「扔下」！

lines.en: scene black
: Sounds like a you problem, Touma! See ya at the finish line!
lines.zh: : 听起来是你自己的问题嘛，Touma！终点见！

lines.en: : Not if I have anything to....ahah! I’m through! I can- ngh! No! Now my lower half is...stuck as well!
lines.zh: : 只要我还有一口气就……啊哈！我过来了！我可以——嗯！不！现在我的下半身……也卡住了！

lines.en: : Should’a skipped breakfast, loser!
lines.zh: : 该省了那顿早餐的，输家！

lines.en: scene obstacles44
: Any last words before I burn this place to the ground?!
lines.zh: : 在我把这地方烧成白地之前，还有什么遗言吗？！

lines.en: : Yes! Let me do it instead!
lines.zh: : 有！让我来烧！

lines.en: scene obstacles45
: Nice try! But if ya ain’t first, ‘yer last! And Miku Maruyama ain’t about to come in last for anything!
lines.zh: : 想得美！不当第一就是垫底！而 Miku Maruyama 可不会在任何事上垫底！

lines.en: : Wha- I thought you didn’t know how to use that?!
lines.zh: : 啥——你不是说你不会用那玩意儿吗？！

lines.en: : I guessed and it worked!
lines.zh: : 我瞎蒙的，结果成了！

lines.en: scene obstacles46
: OH GOD, IT WORKED TOO WELL!
lines.zh: : 天哪，效果好过头了！

lines.en: : My eyes!
lines.zh: : 我的眼睛！

lines.en: : BURN! BURN! BURN!
lines.zh: : 烧吧！烧吧！烧吧！

lines.en: : Imani! The extinguisher! Now!
lines.zh: : Imani！灭火器！快！

lines.en: : Huh? Oh! Oh, right! Hold on, girls! I’m-
lines.zh: : 啊？哦！哦对！等一下，姑娘们！我——

lines.en: scene colorbars
scene obstacles47
: Well, that was significantly closer to death than I planned on coming today.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这比我今天预想的要接近死亡得多。

lines.en: : Yeah...sorry for almost blowin’ the place up. If I’d known that was gonna happen, I would’a told ya to take cover first.
lines.zh: : 是啊……抱歉差点把这地方炸上天。我要是早知道会这样，一定会先叫你找掩护的。

lines.en: : There’s no reason to apologize, Miku! I actually had a lot of fun even if I lost. And I congratulate you on your victory. You were a worthy adversary.
lines.zh: : 没必要道歉，Miku！虽然输了，但我真的玩得很开心。祝贺你获胜。你是个值得尊敬的对手。

lines.en: : I just wish that game would have made any amount of sense at all.
lines.zh: : 我只希望那个比赛哪怕有一丁点逻辑也好。

lines.en: scene obstacles48
: Yeah, but I can kinda see where Imani’s comin’ from makin’ it as weird as it was. The viewers at home want chaos. Nobody’s gonna keep the channel on if we’re just crawlin’ through mud or whatever.
lines.zh: : 是啦，不过我也能理解 Imani 为什么把它搞得这么怪。家里的观众要的是混乱。要是我们只是在泥里爬来爬去的，谁也不会一直盯着这个频道。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say that, Miku. A big thing I’ve learned from my brief time in the world of commoners is that there are some people out here who are into really strange things.
lines.zh: : 这我可不敢苟同，Miku。我在平民世界短暂的这段时间里学到的一件大事就是——外面有些人就是喜欢非常奇怪的东西。

lines.en: : You mean like touchin’ horse wieners?
lines.zh: : 你是说像摸马的小鸡鸡那样？

lines.en: scene obstacles49
: I retract my congratulations. I no longer like you.
lines.zh: : 我收回祝贺。我不喜欢你了。

lines.en: : Well that’s alright with me since I, Miku Maruyama, champion of justice and obstacle courses, have taken round three of the SMUS-DDW: NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB!
lines.zh: : 那我也无所谓，因为我——正义与障碍赛的冠军 Miku Maruyama——拿下了 SMUS-DDW：NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB 的第三轮！

lines.en: : What festivities await us next?! Will the first floor add to its lead?! Or will the evil residents of the second floor tie the game again?!
lines.zh: : 接下来还有什么精彩等着我们？！一班会扩大领先优势？！还是二楼的邪恶居民们会再次扳平比分？！

lines.en: scene black
: Find out right after this word from one of our sponsors!
lines.zh: : 广告之后，马上揭晓！
